quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: H1 2026 revenue RMB 20.91 billion, up 100.34% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 7.53 billion, up 90.98%. Company: revenue rose mainly because it benefited from AI compute investment. Optical interconnect products were RMB 20.88 billion at a 48.46% gross margin (H1 2025: 47.48%); overseas optical interconnect sales were 973 ten-thousand units for RMB 20.46 billion. Financial expenses were RMB 644.11 million (H1 2025: minus RMB 207.95 million), mainly exchange losses.
quarterly_data.figure: RMB 20.91 billion (+100.34%); net profit RMB 7.53 billion (+90.98%); gross margin 48.46%

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: H1 2026 optical interconnect capacity 2836 ten-thousand units (H1 2025: 1520 ten-thousand), output 1091 ten-thousand and sales 1119 ten-thousand (H1 2025: 710 and 695 ten-thousand). Company: core raw materials across the industry chain remain relatively tight overall; turning leading technology into high-yield, stable, large-scale and on-time deliveries is the key, and yield improvement is the core challenge of volume production.

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: inventory rose to RMB 11.66 billion at June 30, 2026 (end-2025: RMB 7.23 billion) as the company stocked up in view of orders on hand, expected orders and stocking cycles; prepayments rose to RMB 869.54 million (end-2025: RMB 16.96 million), mainly material prepayments; other non-current assets rose to RMB 1.80 billion, mainly prepaid equipment and material payments. Construction in progress was RMB 556,998,528.16 (equipment installation RMB 382,714,695.11), self-funded; net investing cash outflow was RMB 1.29 billion, mainly fixed-asset investment.

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: the company released the NX200/300 series OCS products based on its self-developed 3D MEMS technology, alongside the earlier 1.6T DR4 OSFP module based on 400G PAM4, the silicon-photonics 6.4T NPO module and the 12.8T XPO module (company: the industry's first).
